$comment: Accepted debt ceiling for `node cli.js audit` warnings, per type. The audit surfaces existing hardcoded geometry/motion/color as warnings (not build-breaking errors); this baseline ratchets it down. A new component that adds hardcoded values pushes a count above its ceiling and fails audit-regression.test.js. Lower these numbers when debt is paid down; never raise them to make a new violation pass — fix the violation instead.
